svg.aria-label: Repo Scan: a pixel cat inspects a repository file by file without running any code. README.md and LICENSE are clean; SKILL.md (hidden prompt injection), logo.png (an .exe in disguise), index.js (steals SSH keys to Discord) and package.json (postinstall curl | sh) are flagged red. The risk score climbs to 515 with 28 findings and the verdict is DANGER: do not install. Works in Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, GitHub Actions and the terminal.
